issue.title: Bug:[Chassis] platform_tests/api testcases error out in setup

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

This issue is caused by PR #20942 (Update platform api server to support IPv6)
I have added comment to PR about this issue.

This PR is causing all platform_tests/api (150 testcases) to error out in setup.
This PR will not work for a chassis with multiple hardware SKUs.

Example:
test_get_name runs on board202 and cpm and both error out with the same message.
platform_tests/api/test_chassis.py::TestChassisApi::test_get_name[ixre-egl-board202]::setup
platform_tests/api/test_chassis.py::TestChassisApi::test_get_name[ixre-cpm-chassis20]::setup

```
>           res = localhost.wait_for(host=dut_ip, port=SERVER_PORT, state='started', delay=1, timeout=10)
common/platform/device_utils.py:1133:

        if (res.is_failed or 'exception' in res) and not module_ignore_errors:
>           raise RunAnsibleModuleFail("run module {} failed".format(self.module_name), res)
E           tests.common.errors.RunAnsibleModuleFail: run module wait_for failed, Ansible Results =>
E           failed = True
E           elapsed = 10
E           msg = Timeout when waiting for <IP>:8000
E           invocation = {'module_args': {'host': '<IP>', 'port': 8000, 'state': 'started', 'delay': 1, 'timeout': 10, 'connect_timeout': 5, 'active_connection_states': ['ESTABLISHED', 'FIN_WAIT1', 'FIN_WAIT2', 'SYN_RECV', 'SYN_SENT', 'TIME_WAIT'], 'sleep': 1, 'path': None, 'search_regex': None, 'exclude_hosts': None, 'msg': None}}
E           _ansible_no_log = None
E           changed = False
E           stdout =
E           stderr =
common/devices/base.py:134: RunAnsibleModuleFail
```

since fixture duthost_mgmt_ip is called only from start_platform_api_service, all existing cards in the chassis
will have the address of the first card in the chassis.
In the above example address <IP> is the address for board201 in the chassis.  However, when the tests run on board202 or CPM, both use the address of board201 to connect which will cause failure.

### Steps to Reproduce

run the testcase below or any testcase in platform_tests/api.
platform_tests/api/test_chassis.py::TestChassisApi::test_get_name

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual:
Errors in setup

Exected:
The testcase to run.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

Refactor `duthost_mgmt_ip` fixture to be a function inside `duthost` (SonicHost). This is a cleaner way to obtain the mgmt IP of a specific duthost without excess fixture calls.

This method will also select the appropriate linecard duthost for T2 chassis linecards, and originally intends to fix platform_tests/api and gnmi T2 test regressions.
